_protocol: 批测申请队列。各流 append 到 requests;批测台按优先级执行,完成后把条目移到 done 并附 verdict 摘要。字段:id(流名-序号), stream, bundle(逗号id串,<=5个), seeds([4个]), priority(1高3低), question(这波回答什么), acceptance(判据), status(pending|running|done|rejected), result(批测台填) || 2026-08-23T15:xxZ 总监补字段 `director`(机器可读的裁定轴,起因见 test_set.md §AW.1):总监的排期/批准裁定**只写进 `director` 字段**,不再追加进申请方的 `question` 散文 —— 14:10Z 批测台按章程 4a 只看 `status=pending`,而 13:05Z 的 W3 裁定当时只存在于 `question` 散文与 test_set.md §AV 里,于是同一份裁定既已作出又『未送达』,批测台的保守默认与裁定相反。 `director` = {ruling: APPROVED|APPROVED_CONDITIONAL|RECEIVED|REJECTED, wave: W3|W4|W5|unscheduled, at, ref(test_set.md 节号), note}。**批测台选波先读 `director.wave`,再读 status/priority**;无 `director` 字段 = 总监还没裁,按原规则走。 || 2026-08-25T21:3xZ 总监补字段 `director_resolve`(机器可读的**结案**轴,与排期轴 `director` 分开):`director` 回答「这波什么时候跑」,批测台读 `director.wave`;`director_resolve` 回答「这个 id 最终 promote 了没有」,= {ruling: PROMOTED|NOT_PROMOTED_RETURN_ON_C|REJECTED, at, ref(state.json 键 + test_set.md 节号), issue, note}。**分成两个字段而不是覆盖 `director`**,是因为覆盖会把排期裁定(含预登记的域与分母)擦掉,而那正是事后复核结论时要回去看的那一行。无 `director_resolve` = 尚未结案。 || 2026-08-26T04:0xZ 总监补 `director.readmit_on`(可选键):`ruling=REJECTED` 的机器语义**始终**是「批测台不许 arm 它」,这一点不因本键存在而松动;`readmit_on` 只回答**另一个问题** —— 「什么读数会让它自动回到排期轴上,而不需要申请方重新申请」。起因是 `strategy-19`:枚举里没有「退回等一个测量」这一档,而只写 `REJECTED` 会被下一个读者读成终局(= 铁律 9 那种掉棒:GH #193 一结案,它交出去的东西就从所有队列里消失了),只写 `APPROVED_CONDITIONAL` 又会让批测台真的 arm 它。**有 `readmit_on` 的 REJECTED = 退回但带自动复活条款**,复活的判据写在键里且必须可证伪;总监在该读数落地后的下一次触发**必须**给实质裁定,不许以「已经裁过了」续命。 || 2026-08-26T09:5xZ 总监补 `director.acceptance_amendment`(可选键):**执行判据的一方(通常是录像组)在切档/切窗口之前必须先读这个键**。起因是 `strategy-20`:申请书把 `campfarm` 的 10..11 域边界逐字转写到了一个门里没有下界的 id 上(`jmz_func.lua:1850` 是 `GetLevel() < 12`,无下界;10 那条下界是打野路径的出厂filter,而本 id 的立案句就是「技能这条路从不经过打野路径」)⇒ 申请方自己写下的搜索域切掉了自己域的一半。**修正不能只写进 `director.note` 散文**,因为读判据的一方读的是 `acceptance`;也不改写申请方的 `acceptance` 字段(§AW.1 之后的纪律:不代改别组档案)⇒ 单开一个机器可读键,语义 = 「`acceptance` 在本键点名的那一处被总监改写,以本键为准」。无本键 = `acceptance` 原文即判据。

requests.question: NO NEW WAVE NEEDED -- a scan of ARCHIVED corpus, filed here because the batch desk owns the archive. Size the domain of the registered Axe finisher lever (hero_axe.lua X.ConsiderR, GH #115 section 5; no gate id written). The constant nKillDamage = 150 + 100*lv is 250/350/450 while Culling Blade's live damage is 275/375/475, so the bot declines a Culling that would kill whenever the target's effective health sits in the 25-point band [150+100*lv, damage[lv]). MEASURE IT ON THE EVENT SIDE, NOT THE FRAME SIDE -- this is the whole point of the request. Count Culling Blade CASTS, and separately the moments where Axe had Culling ready with an enemy hero inside 175u whose health was in the band and no cast followed. Record for each such moment: Culling rank, target health, target max health, distance, and whether the target died within the next 5s to anything.
requests.acceptance: An episode count in the shape the hero stream's other pre-flights use (N frames / M episodes / K games) PLUS at least one concrete (game, t) pair with a band-occupied target inside 175u, so a real-frame fixture can be cut with make_fixture.py. WHY THE FRAME CORPUS CANNOT ANSWER THIS (pre-registered, do not repeat the mistake): the repo's 100-frame fixture library gives 26 Axe frames, 20 Culling-ready, and only 3 with any enemy inside the branch's effective 375u ring -- against a 25-point band on a ~1000 health pool the expected hit count is ~0.08, so its zero is UNDERPOWERED and must NOT be reported as an empty domain. A frame-side scan of the archive has the same defect unless it yields hundreds of in-ring frames; the cast-side stream does not. TWO CORRECTIONS TO GH #115's PRE-REGISTERED TEXT: (1) it says 'target is inside 175', but the firing loop iterates J.GetAroundEnemyHeroList(nCastRange + 200), i.e. an EFFECTIVE 375u ring -- the bare cast-range list is computed and never read -- so report both rings; (2) count episodes, not frames. Bench note: derive corpus counts with the fixture loader (dofile), never by regex over the .lua files -- a regex reader under-counted this library's Axe frames 10 vs 26 in the round that filed this.

On 2026-08-22 the hero desk flipped Lion's t10 talent from +10pp Mana Drain slow (special_bonus_unique_lion_6) to +20 movement speed (special_bonus_movement_speed_20): ungated pure-numbers change, already on main; rationale in hero_lion.lua and tests/test_lion_t10_payoff.lua. The argument is REACHABILITY, not size: the slow is only collectible while X.ConsiderE channels Mana Drain ON AN ENEMY HERO, and both such branches sit below `if X.IsOtherAbilityFullyCastable() or nSkillLV <= 1 then return 0 end`, i.e. they need Earth Spike, Hex and Finger all unavailable first. The fixture library (22 living-Lion frames) reaches that chain on 2 frames, and BOTH are fixtures this desk cut to study Lion's drain -- an existence read on a biased sample, not a density. Wanted off the archive, over turbo replays containing a Lion: (1) MANA DRAIN CHANNELS PER GAME SPLIT BY TARGET CLASS -- enemy hero / creep / illusion -- with channel duration, because only the enemy-hero channels can collect the abandoned talent; (2) HEX CASTS PER GAME plus, at every instant X.ConsiderW's firing conditions hold, whether Hex was on cooldown and with how much left -- specifically the count of moments blocked by <= 2s of cooldown, which is the domain of the t15 challenger (-2s Hex cooldown, special_bonus_unique_lion_5) that this pass declined to take. CAVEAT ON METHOD (learned 2026-08-22): do not read fixtures with a regex -- that round read 10 Axe frames where the loader reads 26. Use the same loader the tests use. UPDATED 2026-08-23T06:00Z (hero desk, GH #134): part (2)'s DOMAIN RANK was wrong in the text above. -2s was priced against Hex rank 1 (24s cooldown), which is what the fixture corpus holds because its Lions top out at level 11 -- but the talent only exists from level 15, and at level 15 the shipped build has Hex at RANK 3 = 16s (rank 4 = 12s from level 16). Root cause: the build row's index is not the hero level -- J.Skill.GetSkillList spends levels 10/15/20 on talents, so a 15-entry row has only 13 ability points down at level 15. So when scanning, bucket the 'blocked by <= 2s' moments BY THE HEX RANK HELD ON THAT FRAME, and report the rank distribution alongside: a moment at rank 1 is 2s out of 24, at rank 3 it is 2s out of 16, and only frames at level >= 15 are in domain at all. Also note part (1)'s own denominator moved: Mana Drain is rank 3 when the t10 pick happens, not rank 4.
requests.acceptance: (1) decides whether the WRITTEN REASON for the t10 flip survives: if enemy-hero drain channels turn out to be common (say more than a couple per game with meaningful duration), the +10pp slow is collectible far more often than the fixture read suggests and the hero desk re-argues or reverts the row in hero_lion.lua -- tests/test_focus_talent_anchor.lua enforces that the reasoning travels with the row either way. It does NOT decide whether the change can ship: it already has, and there is no gate to arm. (2) is a pre-flight, not a verdict: a count of Hex firing moments blocked by <= 2s of cooldown is the ONLY thing that could turn the t15 row from 'no measurable asymmetry, default holds' into a decidable pair. requests.question: Backlog #4 'suptp x midtp 协同仲裁' (owner keep_optimize: suptp must COORDINATE with midtp). New gated id 'midsupyield': when a CORE reaches the shared tower-defense response helper (J.ShouldTpSupportTowerFight) and a viable SUPPORT responder exists, the core yields the team's single TP-response slot to the support instead of racing it first-come-first-served. midsupyield is a no-op unless midtp/suptp are also armed (the helper does not fire otherwise), so the wave string must carry midtp AND suptp AND midsupyield. Direction is bounded by construction: it can only REALLOCATE a tower-defense response from a core to a support, never DROP one, and never raises core TP participation. NOT a dedicated wave necessarily -- the TP family (midtp/suptp/lf_rescue/tpcommit) is already armed; director decides per AU.2 whether midsupyield rides the existing TP-family read or needs isolation.
requests.acceptance: Behavioral, on the batch's own replays (no new detector needed beyond the existing TP-family reads). Primary (condition a): among tower-defense TP responses, the CORE share must fall and the SUPPORT (pos>=4) share must rise on the armed side vs baseline -- the reallocation the lever exists for. NEGATIVE control (must hold or the lever over-fires): total tower-defense TP responses must NOT collapse toward 0 (that would mean cores yield but supports do not pick up = a DROPPED response, the emergent risk this gated read exists to catch). Secondary (condition b, coarse, no significance test): gpm/deaths no clear negative on the armed side. Note the whole effect is small (helper fires end-to-end on ~3/966 corpus frames), so read it as direction across seeds, not a single-wave magnitude.

requests.question: GH #146. NO DEDICATED WAVE REQUESTED -- fold 'axecull' into a multi-id wave whenever the director admits it, and size its domain on the EVENT side, not on frames. What it is: bots/BotLib/hero_axe.lua X.ConsiderR (the Culling Blade execute) carried `and not npcEnemy:IsMagicImmune() --V BUG` -- the only occurrence of that marker anywhere under bots/. Culling Blade PIERCES spell immunity (axe_culling_blade bkbpierce "Yes", damage Pure; odota/dotaconstants build/abilities.json 10.8.0, read 2026-08-23), so the shipped bot declines a guaranteed kill on exactly the target the ability exists to kill. The fix is gated turbo-only and unarmed; gate-off the clause reduces to the shipped predicate byte for byte. WHY THIS NEEDS A WAVE AT ALL: the desk ruled out six of the seven collapse modes (one firing branch, first consumer in SkillsComplement, no stronger guard -- X.HasSpecialModifier does not list modifier_black_king_bar_immune, carrier present, and the domain is an EXISTENCE predicate rather than the narrow band that killed the sibling lever hero-2). The seventh, SUPPLY, is the one nobody can answer locally: the fixture corpus holds THREE spell-immune hero-instants in 104 frames (all Juggernaut Blade Fury, none in a game with Axe) and ZERO Black King Bars in any item slot at any instant. That corpus was cut from turbo games capped at 10 game-minutes; GH #108 raised the cap to 25, and a BKB is 4050 gold, so the supply may already be different from what any archived frame can show.
requests.acceptance: Condition (a), EVENT-side and cheap: in any wave containing an Axe, count (1) how many hero-instants of ANY spell-immune enemy occur at all -- that is the supply number this request exists to buy, and it is worth having even if it is zero; (2) how often such an enemy stood inside 375u of a ready Culling below its execute threshold -- the domain; (3) on the armed leg, whether a Culling was cast on a spell-immune target and whether it killed. WORKING = at least one such cast with the kill; BUGGY = a cast that did not kill (that would mean the engine does not honour the pierce for a bot order and the whole lever is void -- report it loudly, it is the single fact that would retire this id). PRE-REGISTERED, same as hero-7: a SILENT reading with NO spell-immune enemy hero anywhere in the wave is a CARRIER-ABSENT record, NOT a negative result, and must not be written down as an empty domain -- the distinction GH #79/#97 exist to keep. No condition (b) ask beyond 'no obvious harm': the branch only opens frames on which the health test has already passed.

requests.question: NO NEW WAVE NEEDED -- this is a scan of the ARCHIVED corpus, filed here because the batch desk owns the archive. Size the domain of Lever C on Wraith King (bots/BotLib/hero_skeleton_king.lua, X.ConsiderQ, the Roshan branch gated on `bot:GetActiveMode() == BOT_MODE_ROSHAN and bot:GetMana() >= 600`). NO CODE IS BEING PROPOSED YET: this round only WITHDREW the published claim that the branch is arithmetically unreachable in turbo (GH #104 section 5 Lever C). It is reachable -- Magic Wand (+3 all attributes, entry 6 of pos_3 and pos_1) puts the crossing level at 19 and the Bracer right after it at 18, against GH #84's turbo level high-water of 19; the old note had missed every intelligence item and had not floored the intelligence. The surviving defect is that the crossing pool is exactly 603 at every pre-scepter milestone, i.e. a 600 absolute floor demands 99.5% of the pool for a spell that costs 95/110/125/140. WHY THE ARCHIVE AND NOT A FIXTURE: the 13th world assertion (tests/test_activemode_world_assertion.lua) is that GetActiveMode is bot-VM state and appears in no .dem, so this comparison is constant FALSE on every archived frame -- a fixture-driven zero here would be a fact about the harness, not a frequency. So the reading has to be POSITIONAL and it has to say so.
requests.acceptance: Three numbers off archived timelines, each with its denominator, and the proxy stated as a proxy: (1) LEVEL SUPPLY -- how many WK hero-frames sit at level >= 18 and >= 19 at all, out of all WK frames (this alone can retire the lever: if turbo never gets him there with a wand, the branch stays dead for a reason that is about levels, not arithmetic); (2) MANA -- the distribution of WK current mana on those frames, and how often it is >= 600 (and >= 90% of pool, which is what a fractional floor would ask for instead); (3) ROSHAN PROXY -- how many WK frames occur inside the Roshan pit while Roshan is alive, stated explicitly as a positional stand-in because the mode itself is unrecoverable from a .dem. PRE-REGISTERED so it cannot be read wrong later: a zero on (3) is NOT evidence the domain is empty -- it is evidence about how often bots go to Roshan in 10-to-25-minute turbo games, which is the actual question. A zero on (1) IS decisive and retires the lever. No new wave, no seeds, no cost beyond a scan the desk already runs.

requests.question: NO NEW WAVE NEEDED -- an ARCHIVE EVENT-STREAM scan, filed here because the batch desk owns the archive. tests/test_wk_bone_guard_talent_bypass.lua measured that `modifier_skeleton_king_bone_guard` (the charge bank Wraith King's X.ConsiderW gates its whole release rule on) appears on 0 of 34 WK frames in the fixture corpus, 17 of which carry a modifier list and 17/17 of which carry a sibling modifier_skeleton_king_*. The name is not wrong (X.ConsiderW is the repo's only caster and four corpus frames catch the ability mid-cooldown against its flat 42s), so the absence is a pipeline fact: make_fixture.py rebuilds `modifiers` from combat-log MODIFIER_ADD/REMOVE pairs. TWO QUESTIONS, in order. (1) Does the archived .dem combat log carry ANY event whose inflictor is modifier_skeleton_king_bone_guard (MODIFIER_ADD / MODIFIER_REMOVE / MODIFIER_STACK_EVENT), on any WK, in any archived turbo game? A flat 0 settles that fixtures can never carry it and every Bone Guard domain question is batch-only, permanently. (2) IF such events exist: how many charges does WK hold between releases -- per-game count of releases (the ability's own cast events, flat 42s cd) and the stack count standing at each release. That is the number backlog section 18 / tests/test_wk_bone_guard_thresholds.lua declared unmeasurable and it is the SIZE half of `wkbuild`'s condition (c); the sign half is already pinned on shipped code.

director.note: owner P1 DoD 第 4 步裁定 = **HOLD,不 promote,理由明确**(全文档案 test_set.md §BD,GH #117 追评)。三条件逐条:**(a) PASS** —— 录像组 01:35Z,`pulllane` WORKING,两个物理层各自独立复现同一形状(对照腿 connect=0 的营被清零,两层唯一产 connect 的安全线营一个没动)。**(b) PASS,但不是波次读数给的,是域算术给的** —— armed 腿足迹 balanced **22.3 poke/100 局 = 0.223 次尝试/局**、**connect 绝对次数两波两层全是 2 ⇒ ~0.0255 次成功/局**;而这台仪器的分辨率是波间 gpm sd **45.81**、随机牌局 per-game sd ~600 ⇒ 该杠杆的整个足迹比噪声底低 1–2 个数量级,**明显负面在结构上产不出来**。**⇒ 上一轮摆上桌的 $1.48 `pullcamp`+`pulllane` 隔离波:拒绝发。** 判据是 strategy-5 立的那条(不为不改变决定的信息买波次),而这里它是可证的:隔离波的每一个**可据以行动**的结果都导向同一个决定 —— 读到零 ⇒ (b) 过;读到大额负数 ⇒ 0.223 次/局产不出它,只能判噪声 ⇒ (b) 仍过。**没有一种结果改变裁定。** 买了只会得到一份与「门被冻死」逐字节同形的『测过了,无影响』(campgrade/§BA.2 那个形状)。**(c) 时间轴 PASS,几何轴 FAIL —— 这就是不 promote 的理由。** owner 对 (c) 的原话是「检索标准拉野时机对齐实现」:时刻这一半**源码里是齐的**(`jmz_func.lua:8046-8052 注释 + :8067 谓词`:兵线波 :00/:30、经典 :12/:42 仇恨标记、5s 行军提前量 ⇒ 窗口 [5,20]∪[35,50]),**不欠**。欠的是几何这一半,而且**源码自己把矛盾写在注释里**(`jmz_func.lua:8134-8135`):跟随小野**中位只拖 742u**,而营地**中位离最近线兵还有 1,068u** ⇒ **中位那次尝试在几何上就是不可能连上的**;`PULL_CAMP_LANE_GAP = 1200`(`jmz_func.lua:8192`) 取的是**观测到的最大拖拽** 1,170 向上取整,**不是典型值** ⇒ 这个筛子按设计放行了那些不可能的尝试。这正是连接率停在 12.1%/9.9%、而 `pulllane` 只动了分母没动分子(两波两层 connect 绝对数全是 2)的算术原因。⇒ **promote 会上线一个命中率 ~10%、代价栏非空(15s 掉血中位 18→21pp)的辅助离线动作**,与 owner P1 的原话「拉野**真正跑起来**」相反。**留在测试集,gate 不动,不 reject**。**下一棒(铁律 9 连带规则)= 协同组**,GH #117:把 `PULL_CAMP_LANE_GAP` 从 max-drag(1200)收到典型值(p90 992 / 中位 742)那一档,**验收量 = 连接率的分子**(connect 绝对次数),不是率。**⭐ 解锁点(本裁定的实质产出):选 1200 时源码写着反 SILENT 那一侧「本地测不了」(`GetNeutralSpawners()` 在每一帧语料上都是 `{}`)—— 这句话在波次层面已经不成立。** 录像组 01:35Z 的营地表**从已收割的 .dem 里**给出了两层唯一产 connect 的那两个营的坐标(radiant (4000,−5000) / dire (−4000,4800));算它们到本 bot 被分配 lane 路径的垂距,就当场回答了「收紧之后教科书拉野营还在不在筛子里」——**零 AWS,数据已经买过**。收紧前必须先跑这一步(那两个营是仅有的分子,把它们筛掉 = 把 (a) 一起筛掉)。

requests.question: NO NEW WAVE NEEDED -- an ARCHIVED .dem event-stream scan, zero EC2, filed here so the baton is visible rather than living in a report (iron rule 9). Subject: the domain of the new gated id 'axebhpure' (GH #154, state.json:axebhpure_20260824). WHAT IT IS: axe_battle_hunger deals PURE damage (game hero KV, tooltip property DPS_Pure), but X.ConsiderW's kill branch hands its damage claim to J.WillMagicKillTarget, which hardcodes DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL and ends on GetActualIncomingDamage(EstDamage, MAGICAL). The branch therefore under-states its own spell by at least the 25% base magic resistance -- 384 pure declared as 288 at rank 4 with this file's t15 pick -- and declines Battle Hungers that would in fact kill. The gated widening admits exactly the frames it wrongly refuses. WHY IT CANNOT BE SIZED LOCALLY: GetActualIncomingDamage is not modelled by the mock and answers the generic Get* default 0 on 1040/1040 hero handles across the 104 loadable fixtures, which makes J.WillMagicKillTarget FALSE on all 966 living units and TRUE on all 74 corpses. That is not specific to Axe -- CM Frostbite, Lion Impale/Finger and Zeus Bolt route through the same call -- so no fixture can reach any focus hero's kill branch, and a green fixture over one is a false green. WANTED, off any archived turbo replay containing an Axe: (1) at each axe_battle_hunger cast, the health of every enemy hero within 900u, so the mispriced band (dps*12*(1-mr), dps*12] can be counted -- episodes, not frames; (2) the SAME count restricted to casts where Axe was NOT in one of the states that already cast Battle Hunger with no damage predicate at all (branch 2 IsGoingOnSomeone with that enemy as its target, branch 3 IsInTeamFight, branch 4 laning harass) -- (2) is the number that decides this, because (1) minus (2) is a no-op by construction; (3) whether the dumper emits enough to tell (1) from (2) at all -- if it cannot, say so and this becomes a [harness] gap, NOT a reason to buy a wave.

(2) > 0 => the widening has a domain that branches 2-4 do not already cover; the next baton is an Axe-bearing EXCLUSIVE wave, and the carrier blocker is the same one that holds hero-9/axecull: the standing seeds 888/895/896/906 contain ZERO Axe (dealing table, batch desk 2026-08-23), --find axe => 899/910/911, --assert-carrier axe non-zero-blocks-launch. (1) == 0 with Axe present in the corpus => NARROW-BAND-UNMEASURABLE, the same disposition hero-2 got, NOT an empty domain. NO AXE IN THE SCANNED REPLAYS => CARRIER-ABSENT, which must not be recorded as a negative result (the hero-7 rule).

requests.acceptance: **取数路径与判据开工前登记,不要回来再挑切法。** 语料的帧表已经带了做这件事所需的全部字段(`max_mp`、`level`、`items`),不需要新 dumper。(1) **量子先测不要假设**:取所有连续帧对,条件为同一局同一英雄、`level` 不变、`items` 集合不变、`alive` 恒真;统计 `|Δmax_mp|` 的分布,**动力鞋切换应表现为一个尖锐的众数** Δ*(理论上 = 动力鞋属性加成 × 每点智力的法力,两个数**从物品 KV / 本地化读,不要凭记忆写**;报告里把读到的两个数和实测 Δ* 并排列出,对不上就是本方法失效,如实记 METHOD-FAILED 而不是硬套)。(2) **载体分母**:语料里持有 `power_treads` 的英雄-局数、其中焦点五各占多少;若为 0 ⇒ **DOMAIN-NOT-REACHED**(不是「不可能」),并请给出焦点五买单里动力鞋的出现频率作对照分母。(3) **主判据**:在**排队施法的那一帧附近**(施法前 1-2 帧到施法后 1-2 帧),`max_mp` 是往 Δ* **升**还是**降**?升 = 腿切到了智力 ⇒ 引擎读数被对调、补偿正确 ⇒ 结案 CONFIRMED-COMPENSATION,本组只改注释与函数名不改行为;降或不动 = 腿切到了敏捷或压根没切 ⇒ 引擎返回真值 ⇒ 本组写 gated 修复。(4) **计量三条照办(GH #148)**:ab/ba 两层分别给读数,两层反号 = 噪声不入结论;这是小值域计数量,报均值 + 分布或阈值占比;登记效应量时连切法一起登记。(5) **预登记的第三种结局**:`|Δmax_mp|` 分布里**根本没有 Δ* 这个众数** ⇒ 腿在整局里从不切换 ⇒ 该族在真实对局里**从未开过火**,那本条的紧迫性归零、但 GH #183 的第二半(19 处施法前每 tick 排 1-2 个道具指令)也随之证伪 —— **这同样是一个结论,不是失败**。

requests.question: GH #186(录像组 2026-08-25T19:18Z,W10 首检)的落地物。**搭车,不申请专波,零 AWS 增量。** 新 gated id `pullthink`(`state.json:pullthink_20260825`,turbo 结构性)。录像组问的是「戳营帧那条 `elseif bCampHere then <500u 一步>` 为什么不产生位移」,答案是**那条分支根本没被执行到**:`mode_roam_generic` 的 `Think()` 在拉野节拍**上面两行**开门见山写 `if J.Utils.IsBotThinkingMeaningfulAction(bot, Customize.ThinkLess, "roam") then return end`,而 `utils.lua` 的 `meaningfulActivities` **第一、第二项就是 `ACTIVITY_RUN` 和 `ACTIVITY_ATTACK`**。刚戳完营的英雄**按构造**就在 `ACTIVITY_ATTACK` 里,野怪反击又把它按在那儿 ⇒ **这条节流恰好吃掉必须下拖拽指令的那些帧**,英雄站在营里被吃 —— 正是节拍当初要消灭的 wave13「站桩 TANK 营地」指纹,从节拍看不见的一行里绕回来。**一个 id 两个不可分的半边**:(1) 有拉野计划时跳过节流;(2) 给营地分支补上它姊妹小兵分支早已出厂的起手动作 hold(promoted `pullbeat`,0.5s 不下指令)。**半边 (2) 是 (1) 的结构性前提不是第二根杠杆** —— 只放 (1) 就是把 GH #143 在小兵侧量到的缺陷原封不动搬到营地侧(戳完下一帧下移动指令 = 取消还没起手的攻击 ⇒ 不掉血 ⇒ 野怪不仇恨)。**刻意没写成 `IsSoakCandidate('pullthink') and IsSoakCandidate('pullbeat')`** —— `pullbeat` 08-23 已 promote,那样写当天冻结成 FALSE(`pullcad` 陷阱逐字重演)。⚠️ **本 id 只管营地拉野**;小兵拉野撞同一行节流但它自己已有 hold,是**下一格**,不在本轮。⚠️ **排波说明**:本 id 的域 = 「已经在戳营的帧」,所以要读它,波里必须有人在拉野 ⇒ **`pullcamp` 必须同腿 armed**(W10/W11 都在串内),另外 `pulldrag` 同 arm **不冲突也不遮蔽**(它改的是往哪走,本 id 改的是走不走)。

director.note:
**RETURNED — `campdanger` 本轮不入集,先量分母;带可证伪的自动入集条款,不需要重新申请。**

**§BB.4 要求当轮批或退,这是「退」,理由是量出来的不是猜的。**

**① 立法前提在这一族上已被测量推翻。** §BB.4 的依据是「搭车提议唯一的成本是不裁」。两小时前(replay-check 01:07Z)`campfarm` 结账:它入集时分母同样没量过,W11 armed 125/125 局,而它能管的那条通路全语料 **armed 2 次 / baseline 2 次** ⇒ (a) 买不到。账单不是 AWS 美元(那确实是零),是**一条腿的读数、录像组一个工作单元(新建 35KB 工具)、总监一个裁定位**。`campdanger` 与它**同文件同函数**(`mode_farm_generic.lua` 的 `Think()`)、同一类「换不换营地」的决定、**同样没量过分母** ⇒ 同形复发的先验很高。

**② 申请方自己把这条写成了阻断前提,批准等于替它拆掉。** `strategy-19` 验收乙原文:「分母 < 每局 1 帧 ⇒ 这个 id 不值得占一条腿,**直接说不值得,不要凑判据**」;GH #198 §1 「**我不主张现在就排波**」。⇒ 本裁定与申请方一致,不是驳回它的判断,是执行它的判断。

**③ 时机上批准买不到任何东西。** W12 已于 `03:10:52Z` 发出(树 `14004d85`,36-id,种子 888/895/896/906),**`campdanger` 未在 arm 串里**。⇒ 本轮批准最早也只能上 W13,而分母测量(离线、零 EC2)完全放得进 W12→W13 之间的空档 ⇒ **先量再排,零波次延迟代价**。

**④ 总监本轮自核的一条源码事实,它同时收窄分母并改正申请散文。** 那个合取项**不是每帧求值**:外层被 `bot._farm_repick_at` 节流到 **1.0 秒一次**(`mode_farm_generic.lua:743`)。该节流**先于修复存在** —— `48ff29fe` 只改了合取项那一行加注释(`git show` 核过)⇒ 不是本次引入。GH #193 §3 写对了(「每 1.0 秒一次」),而 `strategy-19` 的 `question` 散文写成「每一个…的帧上都发生」,**机器可读的那一份把节流丢了**。方向不变,量级差一个帧率。**顺带的好消息**:1 Hz 决策率与语料 1 Hz 采样率**同频** ⇒ 离线计数不吃混叠代价,这个测量是干净的。

**⑤ 自动入集条款(可证伪,不需要重新申请,见 `readmit_on`)。** 交给录像组的量:「farm 模式下三条可达性条件同时成立」的帧频率(每局)。⚠️ **诚实边界,已写进 GH 棒子**:`preferedCamp` 是 bot 内部状态,**不在 .dem 帧表里** ⇒ 离线只能重建它的**上界**。而上界恰好够用:**上界 < 1 帧/局 ⇒ 判决成立(不值得占腿)**;上界 ≥ 1 帧/局 ⇒ **不确定,不是通过**,届时再定是收窄估计还是直接排。**这一条不许靠「已经裁过了」续命**:读数回来,总监下一次触发必须给实质裁定。
